title: Who Participates in the Stock Market?

blocks.value: Millions of people participate in the stock market every day. They all have different goals, investment amounts, and strategies.
Imagine This: A cricket stadium has players, coaches, umpires, spectators, and commentators. The stock market also has different participants, each playing an important role.

Retail investors are individuals like you and me. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) include Indian mutual funds and insurance companies. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) are large investors from other countries.
When mutual funds invest thousands of crores into Indian companies, they are participating as DIIs.
Retail investors may buy a few shares, while institutions may buy lakhs of shares in a single transaction.

blocks.question: Who is a retail investor?
choices: An individual investing their own money
